Files copied without changes from [HyperFLAW](https://github.com/LTTM/HyperFLAW) (commit `682b58d`,
`02_adaptation/src/modules/`): DeepLabV3 with a MobileNetV2 backbone and condition-specific batch normalization.
They are licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by their authors. `street2uav/control.py` uses them for the same-label
control of the paper, with one normalization branch for every image.
